title: Reseller Tier Discount on Early Renewals of Web Hosting Plans
content:
**Clause.** The early renewal amount of a Web Hosting Plans plan takes the reseller discount of the customer's Harborline account tier on the date it is paid: an account on Harborline Reseller Platinum, Harborline Reseller Gold, Harborline Reseller Silver or Harborline Reseller Bronze takes that tier's hosting discount percentage under the Harborline Customer Accounts charter, and a Harborline Personal Account or Harborline Business Account takes no reseller discount; the percentage acts once on the regular price and the discounted price is rounded half up to the cent before any credit is applied.

**Percentages by account tier (Harborline Customer Accounts tier discount schedule, hosting discount percentage).** Harborline Reseller Platinum 25 percent; Harborline Reseller Gold 20 percent; Harborline Reseller Silver 15 percent; Harborline Reseller Bronze 10 percent. Harborline Personal Account and Harborline Business Account: no reseller discount.

**Questions the clause answers.**

- *Which tier counts when the account changed tier recently?* The tier recorded on the account on the date the early renewal is paid.
- *Is the percentage applied once or twice?* Once, on the regular price; the result is rounded half up to the cent before any credit.
- *Hypothetical: regular price USD 97.30 on a Harborline Reseller Bronze account?* 90 percent of it is 87.57, so the discounted price is USD 87.57.
- *Hypothetical: the same renewal on a Harborline Personal Account?* No reseller discount; the price stays USD 97.30.
